name: cost_sheet
description: The live price list for pricing work, from the metered costs the platform recorded (falling back to priors where too few runs exist): a research run on each model tier, a Steward pass on each tier, a request's scoping pass, a contribution's review, the paid tools' per-call and per-word charges, and every kind of work on the action ledger that a mandate can fund (assess, reassess, ingest, formalize, proof attempts, curation, audits, lookout runs, review passes). Each line gives a typical figure and the higher figure a ceiling should use. All figures are USD of metered spend, one owl each.
